text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Weren't we not supposed to be able to meet that VIP?

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Apparently they're returning to their country tonight...
but they said they can meet if it's right now.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Please have the car brought around.
And prepare the relevant documents as well.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure?
We had training scheduled for today, though.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: What must be prioritized is the benefit of the family.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I will make up for what I couldn't do today at a later date. There is no need for concern.

And so, Daiichi Ruby ended up
skipping her training...
